activation.note: Activation remains scoped to interlockings, distinguishes applicability from failure, and includes unchanged interlockings at CONFIRM. Task/file hints are qualified rather than treated as sufficient scope; phase and finding explicitly require new observers. Authoring-time guidance applies the existing constraint rather than introducing a new validation phase.

audit.summary: All source segments survive at their claimed destinations, including the two allowed strategies, unique integer priorities, fail-closed behavior, and validation metadata. The rewrite introduces no independent coder obligation or waiver, retains one route-resolution obligation, and uses no shared nodes.

segmentChecks.note: The then and why fields preserve explicit deterministic resolution, fail-closed ambiguity handling, and the unique-priority exception without turning it into a waiver.
Both exact strategy names and the unique integer priority requirement for first_priority are explicit in coder-facing guidance and verifier detail.
The validator type and exact test reference survive in audit, with the executable check also identified in evidence.
The exact validation variant is retained in verifier_detail and as the finding value in activation.
CONFIRM is retained in when, activation, and verifier_detail.
Confirm-blocking enforcement is preserved verbatim in verifier_detail and reflected in activation.
The interlocking subject scope is explicit in given, activation, and verifier_detail, including unchanged interlockings at CONFIRM.
interlocking_id is included in both failure-evidence destinations.
strategy is included in both failure-evidence destinations.
route_ids is included in both failure-evidence destinations.
priorities is included in both failure-evidence destinations.
reason is included in both failure-evidence destinations.

review.summary: The rewrite preserves the route-resolution obligation, both allowed strategies, fail-closed behavior, and all validation metadata at suitable destinations. A weak planner can determine what to declare and how to prioritize routes, while activation clearly separates applicability from non-compliance and identifies the observers still needed.
